hypothesis: A strong completed BTC 1h impulse propagates with delay to some alts. Entering lagging alts in BTC's direction at the next 15m open may capture short-horizon catch-up after costs.

data.parent_data: 15m OHLC, resampled causally to exact UTC 1h bars
data.validation: 2025-2026 SEEN validation; not read in this TRAIN run
data.universe: all non-BTC symbol files in frozen source artifacts
data.liquidity_filter: unavailable/unknown from current frozen OHLC interface; no liquidity claim allowed

signal.btc_impulse: completed BTC 1h range / BTC prior ATR14 >= 1.5 and body/range >= 0.60
signal.direction: BTC 1h close > open => LONG alts; close < open => SHORT alts
signal.btc_norm_move: directional BTC body / prior BTC ATR14
signal.alt_norm_move: BTC-directional alt 1h body / prior alt ATR14
signal.order_live: next 15m OPEN after the completed BTC/alt 1h signal bar
signal.event_ranking: within each BTC event choose largest normalized lag gap (btc_norm_move-alt_norm_move), then symbol

execution.chronology: AGENTS.md section 11 official Binance 1m collision resolution

gates: at least 3/4 calendar years positive at 20bp
at least one adjacent grid config PF20 > 1.03 and ret20 > 0
selection.ranking: ret20 desc, MDD20 asc, PF40 desc, executable N desc
